name: aws-profile
description: Shows each AWS profile above the prompt with whether its login still works, a one-click `aws sso login` in the app's Terminal for the expired ones, and the AWS_PROFILE Claude Code runs with. Production profiles are red.

productionPattern.title: Production profile pattern
productionPattern.description: Regular expression that marks a profile as production (case-insensitive).

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Comma-separated profiles to show. Empty shows every profile from `aws configure list-profiles`.

checkMinutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
checkMinutes.description: How often each profile's login is checked with `aws sts get-caller-identity`.

awsPath.title: aws path
awsPath.description: Full path to the AWS CLI when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
